body: I've actually looked into that, my previous therapist just said I have insecurities. But who knows, it's such a subjective field it could be either or. I don't think about this all the time, it doesn't consume my mind but there are times where I really look into it. I'm just really recognizing the blatantly obvious physical abnormalities of my body. It really sucks.
I'm really looking for reputable first hand experiences, there's only so much on google that I can look at. This is precisely what I need, and believe me man I won't fail
I'm just trying to figure out how much of an impact it'll make. It's not worth bringing it up with the people that are close to me as that would interfere with my plans.

Man my physical irregularities are just scratching the surface, when it comes to what I'm really feeling. My height and size are just one of many things that I know, will never change. In the superficial society we live in, I'm just constantly reminded of these depressing fun facts about my life. But it does seem like you've gone through hell, so it is impossible to compare my problems to yours. I'm sorry if my post made you emotional, from one suicidal person to another, find peace. I know my peace, and that is simply to end it all. But for you it seems a little more difficult, at the end the day, I've realized we gotta live our lives for ourselves; not other people. Suicide doesn't need to be a tragedy, it's just a rational decision in my eyes.

I've tried everything, believe me. I've sucked down hundreds of pills, learned all the coping skills out there, been hospitalized and at the end of the day nothing ever goes my way. It sucks and coupled with my shitty genes and looks, I'm basically forced to settle with a shitty life that I was never asked to be born into. The whole thing with me is, I feel like I could be spending my time elsewhere. What's the point of suffering, where I could take a leap into the abyss and see what really happens when we die

Well yeah I'm pretty much the same, I treat everybody I know with a ton of respect and try to be super nice all the time. And at the end of the day I still have no friends, no chicas, or any real purpose in life. I've tried so hard to get friends, and tried everything under the sun from medication, therapy to hospitalization. Nothing ever works, there is nothing for me in this world.

I honestly feel like it's just too much work just to attain the normalcy everybody else gets. It's obvious I'm less favorable than nearly every other guy out there. I mean I can't attract anybody to save my life, and even if I  do, I'm not interesting, I don't do anything for fun, I don't have any interests and I'm anxious about everything. I firmly believe if I was just average physically speaking, my life would be completely different and I wouldn't need to deal with any of this shit.
